result.title: Towards 360$^\circ$ Embodied UAV Tracking Without Turning
result.summary: Conventional embodied UAV tracking couples target observability with heading control because targets may leave the field of view of forward-facing cameras. We investigate a complementary paradigm that uses full-spherical perception to follow designated targets without active heading adjustment. To support this setting, we introduce 360UAV-ETrack, a simulation benchmark comprising 2,652 sequences, over 1.73 million synchronized observations, eight tracking tasks, and 150 held-out closed-loop scenarios. We propose 360UAV-TVLA, a panoramic vision--language--action (VLA) framework integrating persistent visual referring (PVR), compressed temporal memory (CTM), and geometry-aligned trajectory supervision (GTS) for instance identification, motion reasoning, and three-dimensional control. Experiments across two VLA backbones show consistent gains over standard fine-tuning, with normalized average tracking frames increasing from 22.56\% to 35.28\% for $π_0$ and from 25.68\% to 33.64\% for $π_{0.5}$. Our benchmark further reveals a substantial gap between offline imitation accuracy and closed-loop tracking reliability, establishing a challenging testbed for future research https://libingyu01.github.io/360UAV-ETrack_360UAV-TVLA/

AI.brief_summary: 该文构建全景 UAV 目标跟踪仿真基准 360UAV-ETrack（2652 条序列、八个任务与闭环留出场景），并提出 360UAV-TVLA 框架，以持续视觉指代、压缩时序记忆和几何对齐轨迹监督实现无需转向的跟随控制。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「持续视觉指代」与「压缩时序记忆」涉及跨时间保留视觉证据的内部状态，可供核查 LVR 中视觉细节留存与证据筛选的做法；但任务属闭环控制而非推理期 latent 状态生成，迁移性需判断。
